summary: Align the MCP bundle credential prompt and public safety narrative with the actual iFood CLI contract.
reason: Browser transport generation emitted a generic client-profile variable even though the generated client and tools manifest require IFOOD_BEARER_AUTH; generated prose also incorrectly described confirmation-gated cart commands as read-only.
validated_outcome: MCP configuration, CLI doctor guidance, tools metadata, and public documentation consistently describe browser-owned auth, optional controlled bearer auth, preview-first cart commands, and the checkout prohibition.
